app_subtitle: Maharashtra Statewide Cognitive & Memory Platform for All
welcome_elderly: Welcome! Challenge your memory, focus, and brain fitness with Maharashtra cultural games for everyone.
encouragement_retry: Good try! Let us try once more together.
disclaimer_text: Prototype / Synthetic Demonstration Data — For cognitive training & performance-based adaptation. Not clinical evidence.

memory_matching.title: Memory Matching
memory_matching.subtitle: Maharashtra Cultural Symbols
memory_matching.desc: Train visual memory by matching pairs of iconic symbols: Puneri Pheta, Dhol-Tasha, Tutari, Paithani, and Alphonso Mango.
memory_matching.prompt: Find and tap the matching pairs of Maharashtra cultural symbols.

sequence_recall.title: Sequence Recall
sequence_recall.subtitle: Dhol-Tasha & Tutari Rhythms
sequence_recall.desc: Boost working memory and rhythm by reproducing sequences of traditional instruments: Dhol, Tasha, Tutari, and Lezim.
sequence_recall.prompt: Remember the musical sequence and tap the instruments in order.

pattern_recognition.title: Pattern Recognition
pattern_recognition.subtitle: Paithani, Warli Art & Fort Motifs
pattern_recognition.desc: Sharpen visual perception and motif discrimination with traditional Warli art, Paithani peacocks, and historical fort bastions.
pattern_recognition.prompt: Identify the exact matching cultural motif from the options below.

attention_concentration.title: Attention Focus
attention_concentration.subtitle: Ratnagiri Alphonso Mango Challenge
attention_concentration.desc: Test reaction speed and sustained focus by spotting the ripe Ratnagiri Alphonso Mango while filtering out distractions.
attention_concentration.prompt: Tap the Alphonso Mango swiftly whenever it appears on screen.

daily_routine.title: Daily Routine Recall
daily_routine.subtitle: Healthy Habits, Meds & Haripath
daily_routine.desc: Strengthen chronological planning and executive function by ordering daily living habits from morning water to evening Haripath.
daily_routine.prompt: Arrange the daily activities in chronological sequence from morning to evening.

math_runtime.title: 7+5 Math Runtime Activity
math_runtime.subtitle: Mental Arithmetic & Speed
math_runtime.desc: Enhance numerical processing, mental agility, and quick decision-making with runtime arithmetic challenges.
math_runtime.prompt: Solve the arithmetic equation and select or speak the correct answer before the timer runs out.
